messages.text: BL-1773 🎵 in progress — The post-land re-point that BL-1438 (--land) and hotfix db4da5c573 / BL-1772 (--push) run after LAND_PUBLISHED skips on every land from QA's worktree - its guard refuses 'a parcel in its in_process', and QA always lands while the parcel being landed is in its in_process (land-repoint.log: every QA-worktree attempt since 2026-09-22 skipped for exactly that) - so the QA branch never converges and every land keeps walking ~2700 leftover commits (~20 min): an in-process parcel whose task names the landed ticket no longer blocks; any other in-process parcel still does
